test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 75 workers could complete only one-third of a work in 20 days. It is desired that the work be finished in the next 30 days. How many more workers should be taken to complete the work in the desired time?
solution:
Formula:

M₁ × D₁over W₁ = M₂ × D₂ over W₂

Where,

M1 and M2 = Number of men working on D1 and D2

D1 and D2 = Days for which M1 and M2 worked respectively

W₁ and W₂ = Portion of work finished

Calculations:

Remaining work = 1 - 1/3 = 2/3

Let, the number of additional men required to be y

According to the question,

⇒ (75 × 20)/(1/3) = [(75 + y) × 30]/(2/3)

⇒ 1500 × 3 = [2250 + 30y] × 3/2

⇒ 3000 = 2250 + 30y

⇒ 30y = 750 

⇒ y = 25

∴ The additional men needed is 25.
